72	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
73	# FastAPI app
74	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
75	
76	
77	def _warmup(state: _AppState) -> None:
78	    """Run a silent 1-second chunk through the pipeline to pre-JIT/pre-cache model kernels."""
79	    try:
80	        sample_rate = state.config.get("sample_rate", 16000)
81	        silent = np.zeros(sample_rate, dtype=np.int16).tobytes()
82	        sid = state.session_manager.create_session()
83	        session = state.session_manager.get_session(sid)
84	        state.chunk_processor.process(silent, session.buffer)
85	        state.session_manager.close_session(sid)
86	        logger.info("Model warm-up complete")
87	    except Exception as exc:
88	        logger.warning(f"Warm-up failed (non-fatal): {exc}")
89	
90	
91	if _has_server_deps:
92	    app = FastAPI(
93	        title="Streaming Speech Diarization + Transcription",
94	        version="1.0.0",
95	        lifespan=lifespan,
96	    )
97	
98	    app.add_middleware(
99	        CORSMiddleware,
100	        allow_origins=["*"],
101	        allow_methods=["*"],
102	        allow_headers=["*"],
103	    )
104	
105	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
106	    # Routes
107	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
108	
109	    @app.post("/start_session", response_model=StartSessionResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
110	    async def start_session():
111	        try:
112	            session_id = _state.session_manager.create_session()
113	        except RuntimeError as exc:
114	            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, detail=str(exc))
115	        return StartSessionResponse(session_id=session_id)
116	
117	    @app.post("/stream/{session_id}", response_model=StreamResponse)
118	    async def stream_audio(session_id: str, request: Request):
119	        try:
120	            session = _state.session_manager.get_session(session_id)
121	        except KeyError as exc:
122	            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=str(exc))
123	
124	        body = await request.body()
125	        if not body:
126	            raise HTTPException(
127	                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
128	                detail="Request body is empty. Send raw int16 PCM bytes.",
129	            )
130	
131	        processing_timeout = float(
132	            _state.config.get("session", {}).get("timeout_seconds", 60.0)
133	        )
134	
135	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
136	        try:
137	            loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
138	            result = await asyncio.wait_for(
139	                loop.run_in_executor(
140	                    None,
141	                    _state.chunk_processor.process,
142	                    body,
143	                    session.buffer,
144	                ),
145	                timeout=processing_timeout,
146	            )
147	        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
148	            logger.error(
149	                f"Processing timeout ({processing_timeout}s) for session {session_id}"
150	            )
151	            raise HTTPException(
152	                status_code=status.HTTP_408_REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
153	                detail=f"Processing timeout exceeded ({processing_timeout}s).",
154	            )
155	        except MemoryError as exc:
156	            _state.session_manager.close_session(session_id)
157	            raise HTTPException(
158	                status_code=status.HTTP_507_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE,
159	                detail=f"OOM error — session terminated: {exc}",
160	            )
161	        except Exception as exc:
162	            logger.error(f"Processing error for session {session_id}: {exc}", exc_info=True)
163	            raise HTTPException(
164	                status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
165	                detail="Internal processing error.",
166	            )
167	
168	        latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
169	        rtf = result.rtf
170	        return StreamResponse(
171	            session_id=session_id,
172	            segments=result.segments,
173	            latency_ms=round(latency_ms, 2),
174	            audio_duration_s=round(rtf.audio_duration_s, 3) if rtf else None,
175	            diarization_rtf=round(rtf.diarization_rtf, 4) if rtf else None,
176	            asr_rtf=round(rtf.asr_rtf, 4) if rtf else None,
177	            total_rtf=round(rtf.total_rtf, 4) if rtf else None,
178	        )

181	    async def end_session(session_id: str):

184	        except KeyError as exc:

186	        return EndSessionResponse(status="closed")

197	
198	def _run_wav(
199	    wav_path: str,
200	    config: Dict[str, Any],
201	    output_paths: Optional[List[str]] = None,
202	) -> None:
203	    """Simulate streaming from a WAV file by chunking it."""
204	    import soundfile as sf  # type: ignore
205	
206	    chunk_size_seconds: float = config.get("chunk_size_seconds", 1.0)
207	    sample_rate: int = config.get("sample_rate", 16000)
208	
209	    audio, file_sr = sf.read(wav_path, dtype="float32", always_2d=False)
210	    if file_sr != sample_rate:
211	        try:
212	            import resampy  # type: ignore
213	            audio = resampy.resample(audio, file_sr, sample_rate)
214	        except ImportError:
215	            logger.warning(
216	                f"File sample rate {file_sr} != {sample_rate}. "
217	                "Install resampy for resampling, or provide a 16kHz file."
218	            )
219	
220	    if audio.ndim == 2:
221	        audio = audio.mean(axis=1)
222	
223	    session_mgr = SessionManager(config)
224	    pipeline = Pipeline(config)
225	    processor = ChunkProcessor(config, pipeline)
226	    session_id = session_mgr.create_session()
227	    session = session_mgr.get_session(session_id)
228	
229	    chunk_samples = int(chunk_size_seconds * sample_rate)
230	    total_chunks = int(np.ceil(len(audio) / chunk_samples))
231	    # Trailing chunks smaller than this fraction of chunk_samples are fed into
232	    # the buffer (so timestamps are correct) but their re-transcription is not
233	    # printed — the previous full-chunk result is already the stable output.
234	    min_print_samples = int(chunk_samples * 0.5)
235	
236	    print(f"Processing {wav_path} ({len(audio)/sample_rate:.2f}s) in {total_chunks} chunks...")
237	
238	    for i in range(total_chunks):
239	        chunk = audio[i * chunk_samples : (i + 1) * chunk_samples]
240	        raw_bytes = (chunk * 32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()
241	        result = processor.process(raw_bytes, session.buffer)
242	        if len(chunk) >= min_print_samples:
243	            for seg in result.segments:
244	                print(f"[{seg.start:.2f}s – {seg.end:.2f}s] {seg.speaker}: {seg.text}")
245	
246	    # Final pass: run the full audio through the pipeline in one shot to get
247	    # globally-consistent speaker labels and stable ASR text for saving.
248	    # This avoids speaker-label flips that accumulate across incremental chunks.
249	    # The per-chunk terminal output above is kept for real-time feedback.
250	    audio_duration_s = len(audio) / sample_rate
251	    final_result = pipeline.process(audio, time_offset=0.0, chunk_duration_s=audio_duration_s)
252	
253	    session_mgr.close_session(session_id)
254	
255	    final = sorted(
256	        (s for s in final_result.segments if s.text.strip()),
257	        key=lambda s: s.start,
258	    )
259	    final = Pipeline.group_consecutive(
260	        final,
261	        max_gap_s=float(config.get("group_consecutive_gap_s", 1.0)),
262	    )
263	    for path in (output_paths or []):
264	        _write_transcript(final, path)
265	        print(f"Transcript saved to {path}")
266	
267	    print("Done.")
268	
269	
270	
271	def _merge_segments(accumulated: list, new_segs: list) -> None:
272	    """Incrementally merge new chunk segments into the accumulated list.
273	
274	    For each incoming segment (with non-empty text), find accumulated entries
275	    it supersedes and replace them.  A segment is superseded when:
276	      - same speaker AND >=50% overlap (refined version from sliding window), OR
277	      - identical non-empty text AND >=50% overlap (diarizer speaker confusion).
278	
279	    Because each chunk only covers a ~10 s context window, new segments can
280	    only interact with accumulated entries in that same time range — there is
281	    no risk of chain-reaction removal across distant parts of the transcript.
282	    """
283	    for seg in new_segs:
284	        if not seg.text.strip():
285	            continue
286	        seg_dur = seg.end - seg.start
287	        if seg_dur <= 0:
288	            continue
289	
290	        to_remove: list = []
291	        for k, acc in enumerate(accumulated):
292	            overlap = min(seg.end, acc.end) - max(seg.start, acc.start)
293	            if overlap <= 0:
294	                continue
295	            acc_dur = acc.end - acc.start
296	            min_dur = min(seg_dur, acc_dur)
297	            if min_dur <= 0 or overlap / min_dur < 0.5:
298	                continue
299	            if seg.speaker == acc.speaker or seg.text == acc.text:
300	                to_remove.append(k)
301	
302	        for k in sorted(to_remove, reverse=True):
303	            accumulated.pop(k)
304	        accumulated.append(seg)
305	
306	
307	def _write_transcript(segments: list, output_path: str) -> None:
308	    """Write segments to a tab-separated transcript file."""
309	    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
310	        for seg in segments:
311	            f.write(f"{seg.speaker}\t{seg.start:.3f}\t{seg.end:.3f}\t{seg.text}\n")
312	
313	
314	def _run_mic(config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
315	    """Stream from microphone in real time."""
316	    try:
317	        import sounddevice as sd  # type: ignore
318	    except ImportError:
319	        print("Install sounddevice for microphone input: pip install sounddevice", file=sys.stderr)
320	        sys.exit(1)
321	
322	    sample_rate: int = config.get("sample_rate", 16000)
323	    chunk_size_seconds: float = config.get("chunk_size_seconds", 1.0)
324	    chunk_samples = int(chunk_size_seconds * sample_rate)
325	
326	    session_mgr = SessionManager(config)
327	    pipeline = Pipeline(config)
328	    processor = ChunkProcessor(config, pipeline)
329	    session_id = session_mgr.create_session()
330	    session = session_mgr.get_session(session_id)
331	
332	    print("Microphone streaming started. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
333	
334	    def callback(indata: np.ndarray, frames: int, t: Any, status: Any) -> None:
335	        if status:
336	            logger.warning(f"sounddevice status: {status}")
337	        audio = indata[:, 0].astype(np.float32)
338	        raw_bytes = (audio * 32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()
339	        result = processor.process(raw_bytes, session.buffer)
340	        for seg in result.segments:
341	            print(f"[{seg.start:.2f}s – {seg.end:.2f}s] {seg.speaker}: {seg.text}")
342	
343	    try:
344	        with sd.InputStream(
345	            samplerate=sample_rate,
346	            channels=1,
347	            blocksize=chunk_samples,
348	            dtype="float32",
349	            callback=callback,
350	        ):
351	            while True:
352	                time.sleep(0.1)
353	    except KeyboardInterrupt:
354	        pass
355	
356	    session_mgr.close_session(session_id)
357	    print("\nStopped.")
358	
359	
360	def _cli() -> None:
361	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
362	        description="Streaming speech diarization + transcription CLI"
363	    )
364	    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
365	    group.add_argument("--wav", metavar="FILE", help="Process a WAV file")
366	    group.add_argument("--mic", action="store_true", help="Stream from microphone")
367	    parser.add_argument(
368	        "--output",
369	        metavar="FILE",
370	        default=None,
371	        help="Path for transcript output (default: <wav_stem>.tsv + .txt)",
372	    )
373	    parser.add_argument(
374	        "--no-save",
375	        action="store_true",
376	        help="Do not save transcript to file (print to terminal only)",
377	    )
378	    add_common_args(parser)
379	    args = parser.parse_args()
380	
381	    config = load_config(args.config)
382	    apply_common_args(args, config)
383	
384	    if args.wav:

388	            out = [args.output]

392	        _run_wav(args.wav, config, output_paths=out)
393	    elif args.mic:

396

12	# Environment variable prefix for overrides (e.g. DIASTT_DEVICE=cpu)

16	def _resolve_device(device: str) -> str:
17	    if device == "cuda":
18	        import torch
19	        if torch.cuda.is_available():
20	            return "cuda"
21	        logger.warning("CUDA requested but unavailable, falling back to CPU")
22	        return "cpu"

25	
26	def _apply_env_overrides(config: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
27	    """Apply environment variable overrides (flat keys only, e.g. DIASTT_DEVICE)."""
28	    overrides = {
29	        "DIASTT_DEVICE": ("device",),
30	        "DIASTT_SAMPLE_RATE": ("sample_rate",),
31	        "DIASTT_CHUNK_SIZE_SECONDS": ("chunk_size_seconds",),
32	        "DIASTT_DIARIZATION_MODEL": ("diarization", "model_name"),
33	        "DIASTT_ASR_MODEL": ("asr", "model_name"),
34	        "DIASTT_LOG_LEVEL": ("logging", "level"),
35	    }
36	    for env_key, config_path in overrides.items():
37	        val = os.environ.get(env_key)
38	        if val is None:
39	            continue
40	        target = config
41	        for part in config_path[:-1]:
42	            target = target.setdefault(part, {})
43	        target[config_path[-1]] = val
44	        logger.debug(f"Config override from env: {env_key}={val}")
45	    return config
46	
47	
48	def load_config(path: str | Path | None = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
49	    """Load YAML config, apply env overrides, resolve device."""
50	    config_path = Path(path) if path else _DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH
51	    with open(config_path, "r") as f:
52	        config = yaml.safe_load(f)
53	
54	    config = _apply_env_overrides(config)
55	    config["device"] = _resolve_device(config.get("device", "cpu"))
56	
57	    _setup_logging(config)
58	    logger.info(f"Config loaded from {config_path}, device={config['device']}")
59	    return config
60

62	def _setup_logging(config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
63	    log_cfg = config.get("logging", {})
64	    level = getattr(logging, log_cfg.get("level", "INFO").upper(), logging.INFO)
65	    fmt = log_cfg.get("format", "text")
66	    if fmt == "json":
67	        handler = logging.StreamHandler()
68	        handler.setFormatter(_JsonFormatter())
69	        logging.basicConfig(level=level, handlers=[handler], force=True)
70	    else:
71	        logging.basicConfig(
72	            level=level,
73	            format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s",
74	            force=True,
75	        )
76	
77	
78	class _JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
79	    import json as _json
80	
81	    def format(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> str:
82	        import json
83	
84	        payload = {
85	            "ts": self.formatTime(record),
86	            "level": record.levelname,
87	            "logger": record.name,
88	            "msg": record.getMessage(),
89	        }
90	        if record.exc_info:
91	            payload["exc"] = self.formatException(record.exc_info)
92	        return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)

```text
1	# Live ASR with Sherpa-ONNX
2	
3	*Minimal, light, live speech recognition (and others) on Laptop's CPU*
4	
5	A terminal-based toolkit built with [Sherpa-ONNX](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx). Transcribe speech in real-time from your microphone or offline from WAV files — no GPU required. Also supports speaker diarization, speaker identification, TTS, and speech segmentation.
6	
7	Documentation:  [![Ask DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/badge.svg)](https://deepwiki.com/bagustris/live-asr-sherpa).
8	
9	## Features
10	
11	- **Real-time microphone transcription** — partial hypotheses update live with <500 ms latency
12	- **Offline WAV transcription** — process audio files through the same pipeline
13	- **Speaker diarization** — colour-coded per-speaker output; ASR and diarization run concurrently to keep latency low
14	- **Speaker identification** — identify known speakers in real-time or from a WAV file using neural embeddings
15	- **Unified model loading** — all sherpa-onnx model families supported via a single `--model-type` flag
16	- **CPU-optimized** — runs efficiently on any modern CPU using ONNX Runtime
17	- **Auto model download** — fetches default models on first run
18	- **Endpoint detection** — intelligently segments speech with configurable silence rules
19	- **Rich terminal output** — colour-coded speaker labels and styled status messages via the `rich` library
20	
21	## Prerequisites
22	
23	- Python 3.8+
24	- A working microphone (for `--mic` mode)
25	- Linux recommended (Ubuntu compatible)
26	
27	## Getting Started
28	
29	### 1. Install
30	
31	```bash
32	pip install -e .
33	```
34	
35	> **Note:** This installs all dependencies and registers the `sherox.asr`, `sherox.sid`, `sherox.segment`, and `sherox.tts` CLI commands.
36	>
37	> Japanese TTS uses the `piper-plus` backend rather than `sherpa-onnx`. Install it with:
38	> ```bash
39	> pip install -e '.[tts-ja]'
40	> ```
41	
42	### 2. Run ASR
43	
44	**Microphone mode** — stream and transcribe live audio:
45	
46	```bash
47	sherox.asr --mic
48	```
49	
50	**WAV file mode** — transcribe a pre-recorded file:
51	
52	```bash
53	sherox.asr --wav path/to/audio.wav
54	```
55	
56	> [!NOTE]
57	> WAV files must be **mono, 16-bit, 16 kHz**. Convert with:
58	> ```bash
59	> ffmpeg -i input.wav -ar 16000 -ac 1 output.wav
60	> ```
61	
62	The default Zipformer model (~300 MB) is downloaded automatically on first run.
63	
64	## Speaker Diarization
65	
66	Add `--diarization` to any command to colour-code the transcript by speaker. Two lightweight models are downloaded automatically on first use (~7 MB segmentation + ~23 MB embedding):
67	
68	```bash
69	# Microphone with diarization (auto-downloads all models)
70	sherox.asr --mic --offline --diarization
71	
72	# With a known speaker count for better accuracy
73	sherox.asr --mic --offline --diarization --num-speakers 2
74	
75	# Show [Speaker N] prefix in addition to colour
76	sherox.asr --mic --offline --diarization --speaker-tag
77	
78	# WAV file with diarization
79	sherox.asr --wav meeting.wav --offline --diarization --num-speakers 3
80	```
81	
82	Each speaker's transcript is printed in a distinct colour:
83	
84	```
85	  [Speaker 00] Good morning everyone.
86	  [Speaker 01] Thanks for joining the call.
87	  [Speaker 00] Let's get started.
88	```
89	
90	Diarization and ASR run **concurrently** (using a background thread pool), so the combined latency is approximately `max(ASR_time, diarization_time)` rather than the sum.
91	
92	## Speaker Identification
93	
94	`sherox.sid` identifies known speakers from a reference database using neural speaker embeddings. The default model (`nemo_en_titanet_large.onnx`, ~96 MB) is downloaded automatically on first run.
95	
96	### 1. Prepare a speaker file
97	
98	Create a text file with one `name /path/to/ref.wav` entry per line. Multiple files for the same speaker are averaged:
99	
100	```
101	alice /path/to/alice1.wav
102	alice /path/to/alice2.wav
103	bob   /path/to/bob1.wav
104	```
105	
106	### 2. Run
107	
108	**WAV file mode** — identify speaker in a recording:
109	
110	```bash
111	sherox.sid --wav audio.wav --speaker-file speakers.txt
112	```
113	
114	**Microphone mode** — real-time identification (VAD-segmented):
115	
116	```bash
117	sherox.sid --mic --speaker-file speakers.txt
118	```
119	
120	Each identified speaker is printed in a distinct colour; audio that does not match any registered speaker prints as `unknown`.
121	
122	**Options:**
123	
124	```
125	--speaker-file PATH   Text file with 'name /path/wav' entries (required)
126	--model PATH          Speaker embedding ONNX model (default: models/nemo_en_titanet_large.onnx)
127	--threshold FLOAT     Cosine similarity threshold (0–1, higher = stricter; default: 0.6)
128	--capture-rate HZ     Mic capture rate (default: 16000; use 48000 for device compatibility)
129	--listening           Show RMS energy bar for mic level calibration
130	```
131	
132	### Available embedding models
133	
134	| Model | Size | Lang | Notes |
135	|-------|------|------|-------|
136	| `nemo_en_titanet_large.onnx` | 96 MB | en | **Default**; highest accuracy |
137	| `wespeaker_en_voxceleb_resnet293_LM.onnx` | 109 MB | en | WeSpeaker large |
138	| `wespeaker_en_voxceleb_CAM++_LM.onnx` | 27 MB | en | Good accuracy/speed balance |
139	| `nemo_en_speakerverification_speakernet.onnx` | 22 MB | en | Lightest option |
140	| `wespeaker_zh_cnceleb_resnet34_LM.onnx` | 25 MB | zh | Chinese |
141	| `3dspeaker_speech_campplus_sv_zh_en_16k-common_advanced.onnx` | 26 MB | zh/en | Bilingual |
142	
143	Download any model from the [speaker recognition models release](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/speaker-recongition-models) and pass it via `--model`.
144	
145	## Supported ASR Models
146	
147	All models from the [Sherpa-ONNX model zoo](https://k2-fsa.github.io/sherpa/onnx/pretrained_models/) can be used. Download and extract a model into the `models/` directory, then pass the directory name via `--model-dir` and the architecture via `--model-type`.
148	
149	> [!TIP]
150	> Models marked **auto** are downloaded automatically on first run. All others must be downloaded manually from the [Sherpa-ONNX releases page](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/asr-models).
```

1	import logging
2	import threading
3	import time
4	import uuid
5	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
6	from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
7	
8	from app.streaming.audio_buffer import AudioBuffer
9	
10	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
11	
12	
13	@dataclass
14	class Session:
15	    session_id: str
16	    buffer: AudioBuffer
17	    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)
18	    last_active: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)
19	    closed: bool = False
20	
21	    def touch(self) -> None:
22	        self.last_active = time.monotonic()
23	
24	    def is_expired(self, timeout_seconds: float) -> bool:
25	        return time.monotonic() - self.last_active > timeout_seconds
26	
27	
28	class SessionManager:
29	    """
30	    In-memory session store.
31	
32	    Designed to be swapped for a Redis-backed implementation by replacing
33	    _store operations with Redis calls (all mutations go through _get/_put/_delete).
34	
35	    Thread-safe via a per-instance lock.
36	    """
37	
38	    def __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
39	        self.config = config
40	        session_cfg = config.get("session", {})
41	        self.max_sessions: int = session_cfg.get("max_sessions", 100)
42	        self.timeout_seconds: float = float(session_cfg.get("timeout_seconds", 300))
43	        buffer_cfg = config.get("session", {})
44	        self._buffer_max_seconds: float = float(buffer_cfg.get("buffer_max_seconds", 60.0))
45	        self._sample_rate: int = config.get("sample_rate", 16000)
46	
47	        self._store: Dict[str, Session] = {}
48	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
49	
50	        # Background thread evicts expired sessions periodically
51	        self._reaper = threading.Thread(target=self._reap_loop, daemon=True)
52	        self._reaper.start()
53	
54	        logger.info(
55	            f"SessionManager ready: max_sessions={self.max_sessions} "
56	            f"timeout={self.timeout_seconds}s"
57	        )
58	
59	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
60	    # Public API
61	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
62	
63	    def create_session(self) -> str:
64	        """Create a new session and return its ID."""
65	        with self._lock:
66	            self._evict_expired()
67	            if len(self._store) >= self.max_sessions:
68	                raise RuntimeError(
69	                    f"Session limit reached ({self.max_sessions}). "
70	                    "Close existing sessions before creating new ones."
71	                )
72	            session_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
73	            session = Session(
74	                session_id=session_id,
75	                buffer=AudioBuffer(
76	                    sample_rate=self._sample_rate,
77	                    max_seconds=self._buffer_max_seconds,
78	                ),
79	            )
80	            self._store[session_id] = session
81	            logger.info(f"Session created: {session_id}")
82	            return session_id
83	
84	    def get_session(self, session_id: str) -> Session:
85	        """Return session or raise KeyError if not found / closed."""
86	        with self._lock:
87	            session = self._store.get(session_id)
88	            if session is None:
89	                raise KeyError(f"Session not found: {session_id}")
90	            if session.closed:
91	                raise KeyError(f"Session is closed: {session_id}")
92	            if session.is_expired(self.timeout_seconds):
93	                self._close_session_locked(session_id)
94	                raise KeyError(f"Session expired: {session_id}")
95	            session.touch()
96	            return session
97	
98	    def close_session(self, session_id: str) -> None:
99	        """Mark session as closed and remove it from the store."""
100	        with self._lock:
101	            self._close_session_locked(session_id)
102	
103	    def session_count(self) -> int:
104	        with self._lock:
105	            return len(self._store)
106	
107	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
108	    # Internal helpers
109	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
110	
111	    def _close_session_locked(self, session_id: str) -> None:
112	        session = self._store.pop(session_id, None)
113	        if session is not None:
114	            session.closed = True
115	            session.buffer.reset()
116	            logger.info(f"Session closed: {session_id}")
117	
118	    def _evict_expired(self) -> None:
119	        """Remove all expired sessions (caller must hold self._lock)."""
120	        expired = [
121	            sid
122	            for sid, sess in self._store.items()
123	            if sess.is_expired(self.timeout_seconds)
124	        ]
125	        for sid in expired:
126	            self._close_session_locked(sid)
127	            logger.info(f"Session evicted (timeout): {sid}")
128	
129	    def _reap_loop(self) -> None:
130	        """Daemon thread: periodically evict expired sessions."""
131	        reap_interval = max(30.0, self.timeout_seconds / 10)
132	        while True:
133	            time.sleep(reap_interval)
134	            with self._lock:
135	                self._evict_expired()

1	import logging
2	import time

11	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

13	
14	class ChunkProcessor:
15	    """
16	    Stateless processor that applies the pipeline to a single session's
17	    incoming audio chunk.
18	
19	    Responsibilities:
20	    - Convert raw bytes to float32 numpy array
21	    - Append to AudioBuffer
22	    - Determine the audio window to pass to the pipeline
23	    - Return incremental segments
24	
25	    The context_window_seconds determines how much historical audio is
26	    fed to the diarizer on each chunk for continuity across chunk boundaries.
27	    """
28	
29	    def __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any], pipeline: Pipeline) -> None:
30	        self.config = config
31	        self.pipeline = pipeline
32	        self.sample_rate: int = config.get("sample_rate", 16000)
33	        self.context_window_seconds: float = (
34	            config.get("diarization", {}).get("context_window_seconds", 10.0)
35	        )
36	
37	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
38	    # Public API
39	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
40	
41	    def process(
42	        self,
43	        raw_bytes: bytes,
44	        buffer: AudioBuffer,
45	    ) -> PipelineResult:
46	        """
47	        Process a raw PCM byte chunk within a session.
48	
49	        Args:
50	            raw_bytes: Raw 16-bit signed PCM bytes (16kHz mono).
51	            buffer:    The session's AudioBuffer (mutated in place).
52	
53	        Returns:
54	            PipelineResult containing aligned speaker+text segments.
55	        """
56	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
57	
58	        # Decode PCM int16 → float32
59	        chunk = _pcm16_to_float32(raw_bytes)
60	        chunk_duration_s = len(chunk) / self.sample_rate
61	        buffer.append(chunk)
62	
63	        # Use a sliding context window for diarization continuity
64	        audio_window = buffer.get(last_seconds=self.context_window_seconds)
65	        time_offset = max(0.0, buffer.total_duration - len(audio_window) / self.sample_rate)
66	
67	        result = self.pipeline.process(
68	            audio_window, time_offset=time_offset, chunk_duration_s=chunk_duration_s
69	        )
70	
71	        total_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
72	        result.latency.total_ms = total_ms
73	
74	        logger.info(
75	            f"chunk processed: "
76	            f"chunk_duration={len(chunk)/self.sample_rate:.2f}s "
77	            f"buffer_duration={buffer.duration:.2f}s "
78	            f"total_latency={total_ms:.1f}ms "
79	            f"segments={len(result.segments)}"
80	        )
81	        return result
82	
83	
84	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
85	# Helpers
86	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
87	
88	
89	def _pcm16_to_float32(raw_bytes: bytes) -> np.ndarray:
90	    """Convert raw int16 PCM bytes to float32 in [-1, 1]."""
91	    if len(raw_bytes) == 0:
92	        return np.empty(0, dtype=np.float32)
93	    samples = np.frombuffer(raw_bytes, dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32)
94	    samples /= 32768.0
95	    return samples
96

1	import logging
2	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
3	from typing import Optional
4	
5	import numpy as np
6	
7	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
8	
9	
10	@dataclass
11	class AudioBuffer:
12	    """
13	    Per-session rolling audio buffer.
14	
15	    Stores float32 PCM samples at a fixed sample rate.
16	    Supports appending chunks and retrieving full or windowed content.
17	    Enforces a maximum duration to bound memory usage.
18	    """
19	
20	    sample_rate: int = 16000
21	    max_seconds: float = 60.0
22	
23	    _data: np.ndarray = field(default_factory=lambda: np.empty(0, dtype=np.float32))
24	    _total_samples_written: int = field(default=0)
25	
26	    def append(self, chunk: np.ndarray) -> None:
27	        """Append a float32 PCM chunk. Trims oldest samples if over max_seconds."""
28	        if chunk.dtype != np.float32:
29	            chunk = chunk.astype(np.float32)
30	        self._data = np.concatenate([self._data, chunk])
31	        self._total_samples_written += len(chunk)
32	
33	        max_samples = int(self.max_seconds * self.sample_rate)
34	        if len(self._data) > max_samples:
35	            trimmed = len(self._data) - max_samples
36	            self._data = self._data[trimmed:]
37	            logger.debug(f"Audio buffer trimmed {trimmed} samples to stay within max")
38	
39	    def get(self, last_seconds: Optional[float] = None) -> np.ndarray:
40	        """Return the buffered audio, optionally restricted to last N seconds."""
41	        if last_seconds is None:
42	            return self._data.copy()
43	        samples = int(last_seconds * self.sample_rate)
44	        return self._data[-samples:].copy() if samples < len(self._data) else self._data.copy()
45	
46	    @property
47	    def duration(self) -> float:
48	        """Current buffer duration in seconds."""
49	        return len(self._data) / self.sample_rate
50	
51	    @property
52	    def total_duration(self) -> float:
53	        """Total audio duration ever written (including trimmed), in seconds."""
54	        return self._total_samples_written / self.sample_rate
55	
56	    @property
57	    def offset(self) -> float:
58	        """
59	        Absolute start time (in seconds) of the data currently in the buffer.
60	        Zero unless data has been trimmed.
61	        """
62	        trimmed_samples = self._total_samples_written - len(self._data)
63	        return trimmed_samples / self.sample_rate
64	
65	    def reset(self) -> None:
66	        """Clear the buffer."""
67	        self._data = np.empty(0, dtype=np.float32)
68	        self._total_samples_written = 0
69

122	            f"diar={result.latency.diarization_ms:.1f}ms "

130	    def reset(self) -> None:
131	        self.diarizer.reset()
132	        self.asr.reset()
133	        self._asr_cache.clear()

135	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
136	    # ASR per diarized segment
137	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
138	
139	    def _run_asr_per_segment(
140	        self,
141	        audio: np.ndarray,
142	        diar_segments: List[DiarizationSegment],
143	        audio_offset: float,
144	        chunk_start_time: float = 0.0,
145	    ) -> List[ASRResult]:
146	        """Slice audio by diarized segment boundaries and transcribe each slice.
147	
148	        Segments that ended before the current chunk started are stable — their
149	        audio hasn't changed — so we return the cached result instead of
150	        re-running ASR on them.
151	        """
152	        results: List[ASRResult] = []
153	
154	        # Separate cached hits from segments that need inference
155	        pending_segs: List[DiarizationSegment] = []
156	        pending_audio: List[np.ndarray] = []
157	        pending_stable: List[bool] = []
158	
159	        for seg in diar_segments:
160	            is_stable = seg.end < chunk_start_time - 0.1
161	            if is_stable:
162	                cached = self._find_cached_asr(seg.speaker, seg.start, seg.end)
163	                if cached is not None:
164	                    results.append(cached)
165	                    continue
166	
167	            rel_start = max(0.0, seg.start - audio_offset)
168	            rel_end = min(len(audio) / self.sample_rate, seg.end - audio_offset)
169	            if rel_end <= rel_start:
170	                continue
171	
172	            s_idx = int(rel_start * self.sample_rate)
173	            e_idx = int(rel_end * self.sample_rate)
174	            pending_segs.append(seg)
175	            pending_audio.append(audio[s_idx:e_idx])
176	            pending_stable.append(is_stable)
177	
178	        if not pending_segs:
179	            return results
180	
181	        # Single batched forward pass for all non-cached segments
182	        batch_results = self.asr.transcribe_batch(
183	            [(a, seg.start) for a, seg in zip(pending_audio, pending_segs)]
184	        )
185	
186	        for seg, asr_result, is_stable in zip(pending_segs, batch_results, pending_stable):
187	            if asr_result and asr_result.text:
188	                results.append(asr_result)
189	                if is_stable:
190	                    self._asr_cache[(seg.speaker, seg.start, seg.end)] = asr_result
191	
192	        return results
193	
194	    def _find_cached_asr(
195	        self, speaker: str, start: float, end: float, tol: float = 0.2
196	    ) -> Optional[ASRResult]:
197	        """Return a cached ASRResult whose speaker and time range match within tol seconds."""
198	        for (s, t0, t1), result in self._asr_cache.items():
199	            if s == speaker and abs(t0 - start) <= tol and abs(t1 - end) <= tol:
200	                return result
201	        return None
202	
203	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
204	    # Alignment
205	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
206	
207	    def _align(
208	        self,
209	        diar_segments: List[DiarizationSegment],
210	        asr_results: List[ASRResult],
211	    ) -> List[Segment]:
212	        """
213	        Merge diarization segments with ASR results.
214	
215	        Strategy:
216	        - Each diarized segment defines speaker + time boundaries (authoritative).
217	        - If an ASRResult carries word-level timestamps with text, each word is
218	          assigned to the diarization segment containing its midpoint, enabling
219	          sub-segment speaker splits.
220	        - Otherwise the whole ASRResult text goes to its dominant-overlap segment.
221	        - Diarized segments without matching ASR text get empty text.
222	        """
223	        merged: List[Segment] = []
224	        assignment: Dict[int, List[str]] = {i: [] for i in range(len(diar_segments))}
225	
226	        for asr in asr_results:
227	            if asr.words and any(w.get("text") for w in asr.words):
228	                # Word-level assignment: each word → segment containing its midpoint
229	                for word in asr.words:
230	                    if not word.get("text"):
231	                        continue
232	                    mid = (word["start"] + word["end"]) / 2.0
233	                    idx = self._find_segment_for_time(mid, diar_segments)
234	                    if idx is not None:
235	                        assignment[idx].append(word["text"])
236	            else:
237	                # Whole-text assignment to dominant-overlap segment
238	                best_idx = self._find_dominant_speaker(asr, diar_segments)
239	                if best_idx is not None and asr.text:
240	                    assignment[best_idx].append(asr.text)
241	
242	        for idx, seg in enumerate(diar_segments):
243	            text = "".join(assignment[idx])
244	            merged.append(
245	                Segment(
246	                    speaker=seg.speaker,
247	                    start=round(seg.start, 3),
248	                    end=round(seg.end, 3),
249	                    text=text,
250	                )
251	            )
252	
253	        merged.sort(key=lambda s: s.start)
254	        return merged
255	
256	    @staticmethod
257	    def _find_segment_for_time(
258	        t: float,
259	        segs: List[DiarizationSegment],
260	    ) -> Optional[int]:
261	        """Return the index of the segment whose range contains t.
262	        Falls back to the segment with the nearest midpoint."""
263	        for idx, seg in enumerate(segs):
264	            if seg.start <= t <= seg.end:
265	                return idx
266	        if not segs:
267	            return None
268	        return min(range(len(segs)), key=lambda i: abs((segs[i].start + segs[i].end) / 2.0 - t))
269	
270	    @staticmethod
271	    def _find_dominant_speaker(
272	        asr: ASRResult,
273	        diar_segments: List[DiarizationSegment],
274	    ) -> Optional[int]:
275	        """Return index of the diarized segment with maximum overlap with asr."""
276	        best_idx: Optional[int] = None
277	        best_overlap = 0.0
278	
279	        for idx, seg in enumerate(diar_segments):
280	            overlap_start = max(asr.start, seg.start)
281	            overlap_end = min(asr.end, seg.end)
282	            overlap = max(0.0, overlap_end - overlap_start)
283	            if overlap > best_overlap:
284	                best_overlap = overlap
285	                best_idx = idx
286	
287	        # Fallback: midpoint containment (returns None for truly orphaned ASR)
288	        if best_idx is None:
289	            mid = (asr.start + asr.end) / 2.0
290	            for idx, seg in enumerate(diar_segments):
291	                if seg.start <= mid <= seg.end:
292	                    best_idx = idx
293	                    break
294	
295	        return best_idx
296	
297	    @staticmethod
298	    def _merge_same_speaker_segs(
299	        segments: List[DiarizationSegment],
300	        max_gap_s: float = 0.5,
301	    ) -> List[DiarizationSegment]:
302	        """Merge consecutive same-speaker diarization segments separated by ≤ max_gap_s.
303	
304	        Reduces the number of ASR calls and gives the ASR model more context
305	        by joining short same-speaker fragments before transcription.
306	        """
307	        if not segments:
308	            return segments
309	        segs = sorted(segments, key=lambda s: s.start)
310	        merged = [DiarizationSegment(segs[0].speaker, segs[0].start, segs[0].end)]
311	        for seg in segs[1:]:
312	            prev = merged[-1]
313	            if seg.speaker == prev.speaker and (seg.start - prev.end) <= max_gap_s:
314	                merged[-1] = DiarizationSegment(prev.speaker, prev.start, seg.end)
315	            else:
316	                merged.append(DiarizationSegment(seg.speaker, seg.start, seg.end))
317	        return merged
318	
319	    @staticmethod
320	    def group_consecutive(
321	        segments: List[Segment],
322	        max_gap_s: float = 1.0,
323	    ) -> List[Segment]:
324	        """Merge consecutive output segments from the same speaker separated by ≤ max_gap_s.
325	
326	        Produces a more readable transcript by joining fragmented same-speaker
327	        turns (e.g. back-channel fillers, short pauses) into a single segment.
328	        Available to both CLI and API callers.
329	        """
330	        if not segments:
331	            return segments
332	        grouped: List[Segment] = []
333	        cur = segments[0]
334	        for nxt in segments[1:]:
335	            if not nxt.text.strip():
336	                continue
337	            if nxt.speaker == cur.speaker and (nxt.start - cur.end) <= max_gap_s:
338	                cur = Segment(
339	                    speaker=cur.speaker,
340	                    start=cur.start,
341	                    end=nxt.end,
342	                    text=cur.text + nxt.text,
343	                )
344	            else:
345	                if cur.text.strip():
346	                    grouped.append(cur)
347	                cur = nxt
348	        if cur.text.strip():
349	            grouped.append(cur)
350	        return grouped
351

22	class StreamingDiarizer:
23	    """
24	    Wraps nvidia/diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2.1 (NeMo SortFormerDiarModel).
25	
26	    Processing strategy:
27	      - Accepts audio chunks that are accumulated externally (via AudioBuffer).
28	      - On each call to process_chunk, runs inference on the provided audio window.
29	      - Returns a list of DiarizationSegment with absolute timestamps.
30	    """
31	
32	    def __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
33	        self.config = config
34	        self.model_name: str = config["diarization"]["model_name"]
35	        self.device: str = config.get("device", "cpu")
36	        self.sample_rate: int = config.get("sample_rate", 16000)
37	        self._model = None
38	        self._load_model()
39	
40	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
41	    # Model loading
42	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
43	
44	    def _load_model(self) -> None:
45	        logger.info(f"Loading diarization model: {self.model_name}")
46	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
47	        try:
48	            # NeMo 1.x: SortFormerDiarModel
49	            # NeMo 2.x: SortformerEncLabelModel
50	            from nemo.collections.asr.models import SortformerEncLabelModel  # type: ignore
51	            silence_nemo_loggers()
52	
53	            p = None if not self.model_name else self.model_name
54	            if p and p.endswith(".nemo"):
55	                self._model = SortformerEncLabelModel.restore_from(p)
56	            elif p and (p.endswith(".ckpt") or p.endswith(".pt")):
57	                # Lightning checkpoint: load base weights then restore state_dict
58	                _BASE = "nvidia/diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2.1"
59	                logger.info("Loading base model %s then restoring weights from %s", _BASE, p)
60	                self._model = SortformerEncLabelModel.from_pretrained(_BASE)
61	                ckpt = torch.load(p, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
62	                state = ckpt.get("state_dict", ckpt)
63	                missing, unexpected = self._model.load_state_dict(state, strict=False)
64	                if missing:
65	                    logger.warning("Missing keys (%d): %s …", len(missing), missing[:3])
66	                if unexpected:
67	                    logger.warning("Unexpected keys (%d): %s …", len(unexpected), unexpected[:3])
68	            else:
69	                self._model = SortformerEncLabelModel.from_pretrained(self.model_name)
70	            self._model = self._model.to(self.device)
71	            self._model.eval()
72	            silence_nemo_loggers()  # re-apply after from_pretrained may re-init loggers
73	        except Exception as exc:
74	            logger.error(f"Failed to load diarization model: {exc}")
75	            raise
76	
77	        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0
78	        logger.info(f"Diarization model ready in {elapsed:.2f}s on {self.device}")
79	
80	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
81	    # Public API
82	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
83	
84	    def process_chunk(
85	        self,
86	        audio: np.ndarray,
87	        time_offset: float = 0.0,
88	    ) -> List[DiarizationSegment]:
89	        """
90	        Run diarization on the provided audio window.
91	
92	        Args:
93	            audio:       float32 PCM array at self.sample_rate.
94	            time_offset: Add this offset to all returned timestamps so that
95	                         segments are expressed in absolute session time.
96	
97	        Returns:
98	            List of DiarizationSegment sorted by start time.
99	        """
100	        if len(audio) == 0:
101	            return []
102	
103	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
104	        try:
105	            segments = self._infer(audio, time_offset)
106	        except torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError:
107	            logger.error("CUDA OOM in diarization — clearing cache")
108	            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
109	            raise
110	        except Exception as exc:
111	            logger.error(f"Diarization inference error: {exc}")
112	            raise
113	
114	        latency = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
115	        log_gpu_memory("post-diarization:")
116	        logger.debug(
117	            f"diarization latency={latency:.1f}ms "
118	            f"audio_duration={len(audio)/self.sample_rate:.2f}s "
119	            f"segments={len(segments)}"
120	        )
121	        return segments
122	
123	    def diarize_long_form(
124	        self,
125	        audio: np.ndarray,
126	        time_offset: float = 0.0,
127	        postprocessing_yaml: str = None,
128	    ) -> List[DiarizationSegment]:
129	        """
130	        Diarize audio of any length using NeMo's offline diarize() API.
131	
132	        NeMo's diarize() handles arbitrarily long audio internally via its own
133	        streaming-window pipeline (visible as "Streaming Steps" in the log).
134	
135	        Args:
136	            audio:               float32 PCM at self.sample_rate.
137	            time_offset:         Add this value to all returned timestamps.  Must be set
138	                                 to AudioBuffer.offset when the input is trimmed buffer
139	                                 audio (i.e. when the recording is longer than
140	                                 buffer_max_seconds), so that output timestamps align
141	                                 with the reference which is indexed from recording start.
142	            postprocessing_yaml: Optional path to a YAML file with PostProcessingParams
143	                                 (onset, offset, min_duration_on, min_duration_off, etc.).
144	                                 When None, NeMo defaults (onset=0.5, offset=0.5) are used.
145	        """
146	        return self._infer_via_file(audio, offset=time_offset, postprocessing_yaml=postprocessing_yaml)
147	
148	    def reset(self) -> None:
149	        """Reset any streaming decoder state inside the model."""
150	        logger.debug("Diarizer streaming state reset")
151	        if self._model is not None and hasattr(self._model, "reset_streaming_state"):
152	            self._model.reset_streaming_state()
153	
154	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
155	    # Inference helpers
156	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
157	
158	    def _infer(self, audio: np.ndarray, offset: float) -> List[DiarizationSegment]:
159	        """Attempt tensor-based inference; fall back to file-based on error."""
160	        try:
161	            return self._infer_tensor(audio, offset)
162	        except (AttributeError, NotImplementedError):
163	            logger.debug("Tensor inference not available, using file-based fallback")
164	            return self._infer_via_file(audio, offset)
165	
166	    def _infer_tensor(self, audio: np.ndarray, offset: float) -> List[DiarizationSegment]:
167	        audio_tensor = torch.from_numpy(audio).float().unsqueeze(0).to(self.device)
168	        audio_len = torch.tensor([audio.shape[0]], dtype=torch.long).to(self.device)
169	
170	        with suppress_nemo_output(), torch.no_grad():
171	            # process_signal: raw audio → mel features (batch, n_feat, n_frames)
172	            processed_signal, processed_signal_length = self._model.process_signal(
173	                audio_tensor, audio_len
174	            )
175	            # forward_streaming: features → (batch, pred_len, num_speakers) sigmoid probs
176	            total_preds = self._model.forward_streaming(processed_signal, processed_signal_length)
177	
178	        # transpose to (num_speakers, pred_len) for _parse_activity_tensor
179	        activity = total_preds[0].T
180	        ws = getattr(self._model.preprocessor._cfg, "window_stride", 0.01)
181	        ss = getattr(self._model.sortformer_modules, "subsampling_factor", 8)
182	        frame_duration = ws * ss
183	        return self._parse_activity_tensor(activity, offset, frame_duration)
184	
185	    def _parse_activity_tensor(
186	        self, activity: torch.Tensor, offset: float, frame_duration: float = 0.01
187	    ) -> List[DiarizationSegment]:
188	        """
189	        Convert a (num_speakers, num_frames) boolean/float activity tensor to segments.
190	        frame_duration: seconds per prediction frame (default 10 ms for raw feature frames;
191	                        use window_stride * subsampling_factor for post-encoder frames).
192	        """
193	        segments: List[DiarizationSegment] = []
194	        activity = (activity.cpu() > 0.5).numpy()  # (num_speakers, num_frames)
195	
196	        for spk_idx, spk_activity in enumerate(activity):
197	            in_segment = False
198	            seg_start = 0.0
199	            for frame_idx, active in enumerate(spk_activity):
200	                t = frame_idx * frame_duration
201	                if active and not in_segment:
202	                    seg_start = t
203	                    in_segment = True
204	                elif not active and in_segment:
205	                    segments.append(
206	                        DiarizationSegment(
207	                            speaker=f"spk_{spk_idx}",
208	                            start=seg_start + offset,
209	                            end=t + offset,
210	                        )
211	                    )
212	                    in_segment = False
213	            if in_segment:
214	                end_t = len(spk_activity) * frame_duration
215	                segments.append(
216	                    DiarizationSegment(
217	                        speaker=f"spk_{spk_idx}",
218	                        start=seg_start + offset,
219	                        end=end_t + offset,
220	                    )
221	                )
222	        return segments
223	
224	    def _infer_via_file(
225	        self,
226	        audio: np.ndarray,
227	        offset: float,
228	        postprocessing_yaml: str = None,
229	    ) -> List[DiarizationSegment]:
230	        """File-based diarization using NeMo's diarize() API."""
231	        import soundfile as sf  # type: ignore
232	
233	        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=True) as tmp:
234	            sf.write(tmp.name, audio, self.sample_rate)
235	            try:
236	                # diarize() returns List[List[str]], one inner list per audio file.
237	                # Each string: "begin_seconds end_seconds speaker_label"
238	                result = self._model.diarize(
239	                    [tmp.name],
240	                    verbose=False,
241	                    postprocessing_yaml=postprocessing_yaml,
242	                )
243	            except Exception as exc:
244	                logger.error(f"File-based diarization error: {exc}")
245	                raise
246	        per_file = result[0] if result else []
247	        return self._parse_diarize_output(per_file, offset)
248	
249	    @staticmethod
250	    def _parse_diarize_output(segments: List[str], offset: float) -> List[DiarizationSegment]:
251	        """Parse NeMo diarize() output: list of 'begin_s end_s speaker_label' strings."""
252	        result: List[DiarizationSegment] = []
253	        for line in segments:
254	            parts = line.strip().split()
255	            if len(parts) >= 3:
256	                start = float(parts[0]) + offset
257	                end = float(parts[1]) + offset
258	                speaker = parts[2]
259	                result.append(DiarizationSegment(speaker, start, end))
260	        return sorted(result, key=lambda s: s.start)

327	                )
328	            except TypeError:
329	                transcriptions = self._model.transcribe([audio], batch_size=self.batch_size)
330	        if not transcriptions:
331	            return None
332	        text = transcriptions[0]
333	        if hasattr(text, "text"):
334	            text = text.text
335	        text = str(text).strip()
336	        if not text:
337	            return None
338	        return ASRResult(text=text, start=start, end=end)
339	
340

345	class ReazonSpeechNeMoBackend(ParakeetBackend):
346	    """reazon-research/reazonspeech-nemo-v2 via NeMo.

349	    default model name.
